questions.question: In render/json.go, what does JSON.Render do if WriteJSON returns a non-nil error?
questions.answer: It panics with that error via panic(err).

questions.question: In render/json.go, under what condition does SecureJSON.Render write the Prefix before the marshaled JSON data?
questions.answer: When the marshaled JSON bytes start with "[" and end with "]" (i.e., the data is a JSON array).

questions.question: In mode.go, what does the Mode() function return?
